mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past month signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces the cost of capital for corporations, leading to higher equity valuations and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS has declined over the prior month, or the Rank IC falls below 0.02 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 4.5% and has risen by more than 0.5 percentage points in the past three months, it signals a tightening monetary cycle that increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS > 4.5% and FEDFUNDS rise > 0.5pp in 3 months
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when the trigger condition is met, or the Rank IC is below 0.02 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in the unemployment rate and increase in nonfarm payrolls signals strong labor market conditions that boost corporate earnings growth, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days through a joint effect of labor supply and demand.
failure_condition: The joint effect of UNRATE decline and PAYEMS increase does not produce positive 60-day returns in more than 55% of cases, or the interaction term in a regression has a p-value > 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: In a housing market recovery regime (HOUST > 1300), rising new home construction signals strong consumer confidence and increased spending, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when HOUST > 1300, or the Rank IC is below 0.02 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production falls below 100.0 and has declined for two consecutive months, it signals a weakening manufacturing sector that reduces corporate profits, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO < 100.0 and INDPRO decline > 0.0 in 2 months
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when INDPRO < 100.0 and declining for two months, or the Rank IC is below 0.02 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real sales of retail and food services (RSAFS) over the past two months indicates strong consumer spending, which supports corporate revenue growth and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when RSAFS has increased over the prior two months, or the Rank IC is below 0.02 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in the federal funds rate and decline in the core inflation rate signals a 'soft landing' monetary policy that reduces recession risk, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days through the joint effect of rate hikes and disinflation.
failure_condition: The joint effect of FEDFUNDS rise and CPIAUCSL decline does not produce positive 20-day returns in more than 55% of cases, or the interaction term in a regression has a p-value > 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 4.5% and has risen by more than 0.2 percentage points in the past three months, it signals a deteriorating labor market that reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE > 4.5% and UNRATE rise > 0.2pp in 3 months
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE > 4.5% and rising for three months, or the Rank IC is below 0.02 over a 3-year rolling window.
